notes: The lifecycle every brand is measured against. Each moment is a flow (or a branch of one) with its trigger, timing, who is eligible, what takes them out, the message steps and what success means. optimal_journey.py marks each moment and step keep / fix / build / validate against the brand's live flows. day is days after entry (after the flow's first send when anchor is first_send, for flows whose trigger fires before the moment starts, like a winback timed from the last order); window is how far a live message's timing may sit from it and still count as that step. kinds are audit.flows flow kinds; name matches a live flow (or one of its messages) by name; with neither, live flows at the moment's stage that no other moment claims by name.
principles: Every moment a customer can be in has one clear next message, and only one flow speaks at a time.
Intent flows go out fast: the first reminder within an hour, before intent fades.
Lead with help and proof; hold discounts for later steps and for people who need them.
Every flow exits on purchase, and every send respects the account's suppression rules.
Each step is measured on revenue per recipient and unsubscribes; weak steps are rewritten or cut.

stages.goal: Turn a new subscriber into a first-time buyer.
Bring product viewers back to the product.
Recover checkouts, the highest-intent moment in the journey.
Make the first order go well and earn the second.
Be there when they're about to run out.
Bring lapsed buyers back before they're gone.
Protect deliverability by letting the unengaged go.

moments.title: Welcome series
moments.trigger: Joins the newsletter list or submits a sign-up form
moments.eligibility: New email subscribers who haven't bought
moments.success_metric: First-order rate of new subscribers within 14 days
guardrails: Deliver the promised offer in the first email
Smart Sending can be off for email 1 only

steps.job: Deliver what the sign-up promised and set expectations
Confirm the offer by text for SMS subscribers
Why the brand exists and what makes the product different
Best sellers with reviews and proof
Offer reminder before it expires, answering the top objection

moments.title: Non-buyer nurture
moments.name: nurture|education|non[\s-]?buyer
moments.trigger: Finished the welcome series without buying
moments.success_metric: First orders from subscribers older than 7 days
guardrails: No new discount: reuse the welcome offer or none

steps.job: Education: how to choose the right product
Customer stories and social proof
Last nudge with the guarantee and shipping promise

moments.title: Browse abandonment
moments.eligibility: Known profiles who viewed and didn't add to cart
moments.exits: Adds to cart, starts checkout or places an order
moments.success_metric: Revenue per recipient of the browse flow
guardrails: Skip people who got a browse email in the last 7 days

steps.job: The product they viewed, with its best review
Similar products and best sellers in the category

moments.title: Abandoned cart
moments.eligibility: Profiles who added to cart and didn't start checkout
moments.exits: Starts checkout or places an order
guardrails: Discount only from email 3, and only if margin allows

steps.job: Plain reminder of the cart, with the product image
Answer the top objection: shipping, returns, reviews
Last chance, with an incentive if the brand allows one

moments.title: Abandoned checkout
moments.eligibility: Profiles who started checkout and didn't order
guardrails: Exit on purchase at every step

steps.job: Reminder with the cart, one button back to checkout
Short text with a link back to checkout
Reassurance: reviews, guarantee, shipping times
Final reminder, with an incentive if the brand allows one

moments.title: Post-purchase onboarding
guardrails: No hard sell before the order arrives

steps.job: Thank you, what happens next and when it ships
How to get the most from the product
Ask for a review while the product is fresh

moments.title: First-to-second order
moments.name: cross[\s-]?sell|upsell|second order|next order|repeat purchase
moments.eligibility: First-time buyers with no second order
guardrails: Offer only if repeat rate needs it

steps.job: What pairs with what they bought
Best sellers they haven't tried, with proof

moments.title: Replenishment
moments.trigger: Placed Order, timed to the product's usage cycle
moments.success_metric: Reorder rate inside the usage window
guardrails: Time from the product's real reorder interval, not a guess

steps.job: Running low? One click to reorder the same thing
Reminder, with a subscribe-and-save option if offered

moments.title: Winback
moments.trigger: No order in about 1.5x the typical time between orders
guardrails: Escalate the offer gradually; never open with the deepest discount

steps.job: We miss you: what's new since their last order
Their past favourite, with proof it's still loved
Best offer, with a clear end date

moments.title: Sunset
moments.trigger: No opens, clicks or site visits in 90+ days
moments.success_metric: Share of sends to engaged profiles; spam complaint rate
guardrails: Suppress anyone who doesn't engage after the last step

steps.job: Still want to hear from us? One click to stay
Last email before we stop sending, then suppress
